name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO Strategist | Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Technical Audits & AI Search Visibility
summary: Hands-on local SEO practitioner with 4 years of concentrated SEO work inside 15+ years of digital marketing. Runs local SEO for service businesses at Solenzo: Google Business Profile setup and optimization first on every account, then technical audits in Screaming Frog, schema, on-page fixes implemented directly in the CMS, and GTM, GA4, and Search Console on every site. Onboarded 15-20 reseller partners onto Birdeye's listings data-aggregator product, making sure every end customer's listings were correct across the directory network. Built an automated SEO and AI-visibility audit that scores a site across 16 dimensions, tests how AI models recommend it, and flags the gaps, so AI search is part of the work, not an afterthought.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Claim, verify, and optimize Google Business Profile listings (categories, descriptions, services, photos, posts) as the first deliverable on every client account, the foundation of each local SEO program.
Run technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research with Screaming Frog, and implement fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify and implement schema and structured data as part of every technical audit.
Install and configure Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every site launched, and use Search Console to monitor indexing, queries, and technical health.

Built an automated SEO and AI-visibility audit that scores a business across 16 dimensions, tests how AI models recommend it, and benchmarks it against its top competitor; Solenzo's audit funnel has enrolled 180+ businesses.
Write SEO content, blog posts, and landing-page copy, and report organic performance with prioritized next steps.

Guided partners through technical setup of listings, reviews, and reputation tools across health, home services, and retail.
